title: Unreal Stamina's
description: Adds a stamina bar above your hearts. Sprinting drains stamina and exhaustion blocks sprint until fully recovered. Includes an Adrenaline potion that stacks duration. Creative mode excluded.
body:
# Unreal Stamina

A survival-focused stamina mod that adds a stamina bar above your health,
sprint management, exhaustion states, and an Adrenaline potion.

---

## Features

### Stamina Bar
A stamina bar with 10 segments sits directly above the health bar.
It drains as you sprint and regenerates passively when you stop.

### Sprint Management
- Sprinting consumes 1 stamina point every 1.5 seconds.
- When stamina reaches zero, you enter an **exhausted state**.
- While exhausted, sprinting is completely blocked until stamina is **fully recovered**.

### Passive Regeneration
- Stamina regenerates automatically while not sprinting.
- A short catch-breath delay applies after reaching zero.

### Adrenaline Potion Effect
A new beneficial effect that restores stamina over time.
Taking multiple Adrenaline potions **stacks** the duration.

| Potion | Duration | Amplifier |
|---|---|---|
| Adrenaline | 45s | I |
| Long Adrenaline | 90s | I |
| Strong Adrenaline | 20s | II |

### Brewing Recipes
- **Swiftness + Blaze Powder** → Adrenaline
- **Adrenaline + Redstone** → Long Adrenaline
- **Adrenaline + Glowstone Dust** → Strong Adrenaline II

---

## Visual Feedback
- Segment shake animation when a stamina point is lost.
- Vanilla-style regeneration bounce animation.
- Segments flicker independently when stamina is at zero.

---

## Compatibility
- Creative and Spectator modes are fully excluded from stamina drain.
- Compatible with AppleSkin for food HUD preview integration.

---
